headline: Premier League Saturday: Chelsea host Tottenham in London derby at Stamford Bridge
whyCareReason: London rivals collide at Stamford Bridge. Chelsea sit fourth on 13 points, Spurs 16th on 6 points.
teaser: Saturday 24 October, 17:30 UK, Stamford Bridge, Sky Sports. City lead table on 21; Arsenal have 18.
story: Matchweek 8 reaches its fever pitch on Saturday, 24 October, as Chelsea host Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge (17:30 UK). Spurs arrive with fresh confidence after securing their first league win of the campaign with a 3-1 comeback against Coventry City on Monday, lifting them to 16th place on 6 points. Chelsea occupy fourth position on 13 points (4-1-2), aiming to close the gap on second-placed Arsenal (18) and leaders Manchester City (21). Friday's opener saw Ipswich Town and Nottingham Forest draw 1-1 at Portman Road.
stakes: Spurs look to build momentum out of the bottom half while Chelsea aim to keep pace with the league leaders.
rivalryAngle: Fierce London rivals meet at Stamford Bridge five days after Spurs climbed off the bottom.
funFacts: Saturday 24 October, 17:30 UK, Stamford Bridge, Sky Sports. Kickoff today.
Table: City 21 (7-0-0), Arsenal 18, Brighton 16, Chelsea 13, Liverpool 12.
Friday final: Ipswich Town 1, Nottingham Forest 1 (Enciso 41', Williams 13').
